title: aqe_alert_notice.v1
description: ONE machine-readable notice per AQE alert cycle, written by src/alerts/notice.py from the SAME cards the [AQE] email renders (so email and cockpit cannot disagree). Published every in-window cycle: Drive `aqe_alert_notice.json` (latest), GitHub `aegis/output/alerts/live/latest.json` (latest) and `aegis/output/alerts/live/<YYYY-MM-DD>.json` (the day's cycles, newest first). Read by aegis-live/tools/aqe_notice.py, which renders the executive table in the cockpit. AQE makes no decisions and no sizing: `action` is the plan's own plain verb, `entry/stop/target` are the committee's (or AQE-default) levels; share counts are the reader's arithmetic on the Aegis 1R, never AQE's.

seq.description: Monotonic per day (resets at the first in-window cycle of a new ET date). The reader dedups on (session_date, seq).

session_date.description: US session date (ET) this cycle belongs to, YYYY-MM-DD.

data.description: Which data this cycle ran on -- the same meta the email's `Data:` line prints.

pma_missing.description: Set (latest session seen) when no PMA file for today's session: no committee names this cycle.

aqe_current.description: False = export older than the last close; AQE-default names were skipped.

market.description: R40 market_kill as evaluated this cycle. State only -- the reader prints NO market sentence (PM 2026-11-02); a confirmed break appears once as a normal item (class MARKET, severity RISK).

broken.description: Sticky for the session once a break confirms.

just_broke.description: True on the one cycle the break confirmed.

actionable.description: True iff items is non-empty or market.just_broke. A quiet cycle is a real answer: actionable=false with quiet_line set.

items.description: Every name whose state changed this cycle (one per card in the email), severity ACT first, then RISK, then INFO.

states.description: Condition-state names that fired (CONDITION_MET, FAILED_PUSH, CHASED, UNR_TRIGGER, UNR_FAILED, EXIT_LINE_HELD) or, for a held-position event, the engine kind (near_stops, approaching_target, close_below, trade_below, no_stop_order, order_config, VETO_HELD).

severity.description: ACT = an entry condition the plan says to act on; RISK = a held name's stop/exit/veto/order check; INFO = everything else (back under, chased, failed).

headline.description: The card headline, verbatim from the email.

action.description: Plain verb from the plan, never a recommendation: e.g. 'Buy trigger hit: queue the Tiger preview on your word', 'Back under its buy price: wait', 'Near your broker stop: check it'.

entry.description: The buy level in force (committee or AQE-default); the U&R trigger price when the state is a U&R entry.

stop.description: Committee stop, or the U&R low-of-day stop for a U&R state, or the broker stop for a held name.

stop_type.description: committee | aqe_atr_fallback | unr_low_of_day | broker | committee_exit | unknown

risk_per_share.description: entry - stop when both known and entry > stop.

lines.description: The card's plain lines, verbatim from the email, for the reader to expand on request.

setups_forming.description: Names that are only a U&R setup forming this cycle (the email's one-line rows). Never actionable on their own.

suppressed.description: Entry states/triggers this cycle that were suppressed by a broken market condition (ledgered, not shown).

quiet_line.description: Set when not actionable: 'HH:MM SGT · AQE: no trigger, no action.' -- the reader prints it or stays silent per its own cadence rule.

email.description: What the parallel email channel did this cycle -- the parity evidence for the cut-over.
